# Plugin development

The plugin guide, a gallery of the shared components, and hot reload that waits for idle.

Pack id `develop`. Back to [all packs](README.md).

## Enable it

1. In the app: **Knowledge › Getting started**, then **Enable pack** on Plugin development under Packs. It previews exactly what changes; **Disable pack** reverses it.
2. From an Agent: the `onboarding_pack_apply` tool with pack `develop`. It runs only when you ask, after showing the preview.
3. From a shell: `dshx init --profile <name> --packs develop` (Core is added; `--dry-run` previews). See [`dshx init`](../../tooling/dshx/docs/cli-reference.md#dshx-init-compose-a-profile-from-packs).

## Restart

Installing a plugin the profile does not have yet needs a DSH Host restart: DSH reads the profile once at boot. Plugins already installed are switched on in the running DSH. Nothing restarts on its own: use **Restart when idle** in the sidebar when DSH runs under the managed launcher, otherwise your own launcher.
